loss_scenario_description: Corporate payment APIs unavailable for treasury and ERP integrations

Standing orders not executed on due date
Exposure or misuse of API keys for external partners

Inability to monitor merchant risk and anomalies
Loan accounts and schedules not updated
Customers can view accounts but cannot initiate payments
Inability to provide transaction surveillance reports on time
Sanctions and PEP screening engine unavailable
